voices.name: l00
voices.text: When a lobster grows, <#0.2#> its shell squeezes, and it hurts.
voices.caption: When a lobster grows, its shell squeezes, and it hurts.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: So it hides under a rock, <#0.2#> and sheds the shell.
voices.caption: So it hides under a rock, and sheds the shell.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Then it waits, alone, <#0.2#> until the new one hardens.
voices.caption: Then it waits, alone, until the new one hardens.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Does everything feel uncomfortable lately, <#0.2#> and you just want to hide?
voices.caption: Does everything feel uncomfortable lately, and you just want to hide?

voices.name: l04
voices.text: You're not falling apart. <#0.3#> It's a sign that you've grown.
voices.caption: You're not falling apart. It's a sign that you've grown.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: It's okay to hide for now. <#0.2#> Your new shell is growing.
voices.caption: It's okay to hide for now. Your new shell is growing.
